descriptions.beetle: Actively chases enemies in sight and deals contact damage. Leave yourself room to move when it approaches.
descriptions.bandage_beetle: An aggressive beetle wrapped in bandages. Lethal damage triggers a brief undead state, so it can remain dangerous after its health runs out.
descriptions.normal_ladybug: Wanders until provoked, then chases its attacker. Its gentle appearance does not make contact safe.
descriptions.mecha_flower: A mechanical flower armed with cogwheel petals. It fights at range and carries more cogwheels at higher rarities, up to its slot limit.
descriptions.normal_flower: A wild flower that actively approaches enemies. Watch both its body and any petals it carries.
descriptions.soldier_ant: A melee ant that actively chases enemies and deals contact damage. Several approaching together can leave little room to dodge.
descriptions.soldier_fire_ant: An aggressive melee soldier of the fire ants. Eggs laid by a fire queen also hatch into these soldiers.
descriptions.soldier_termite: An aggressive termite soldier. Its psionic connection shares damage with nearby allies that also have the connection.
descriptions.summoned_beetle: A companion hatched from a Beetle Egg petal. It follows its owner and fights nearby enemies within its owner's roaming range.
descriptions.summoned_soldier_ant: A soldier summoned by an Ant Egg petal. It fights for its owner and follows when its owner moves away.
descriptions.bee: Flies along a wavering path and chases attackers when provoked. Honey can draw its attention.
descriptions.hornet: Keeps its distance while firing missiles. Super and higher rarities use additional attack patterns.
descriptions.bumble_bee: Wanders along a wavering flight path and is attracted to honey. Periodically leaves pollen behind.
descriptions.rock: An obstacle that does not move on its own and can deal contact damage. At Super and higher rarities, taking damage can spawn lower-rarity rocks.
descriptions.bubble: A bubble that does not pursue targets but can be pushed around. At Super and higher rarities, taking damage can spawn lower-rarity bubbles.
descriptions.crab: Circles its target before dashing in a straight line. Move sideways once it commits to a dash.
descriptions.jellyfish: Periodically releases chain lightning against player flowers in range, even without a locked target.
descriptions.baby_ant: A young ant that wanders without pursuing enemies. Breaking an ordinary ant egg may release one.
descriptions.worker_ant: A wild worker that wanders until provoked. The workers that carry food in Ant Kingdom use separate behavior.
descriptions.queen_ant: Lays eggs during combat that hatch into soldier ants after a delay. A prolonged fight can bring more enemies.
descriptions.ant_hole: Releases waves of ants as damage pushes its health past thresholds. Breaking the nest still releases the remaining waves.
descriptions.spider: Actively pursues enemies. Legendary and higher rarities leave web patches while chasing, slowing enemies that enter them.
descriptions.sandstorm: A wandering sandstorm that deals contact damage. It does not lock onto enemies, so watch its path before crossing.
descriptions.dummy: A stationary training target that restores its health and records damage. Sustained attacks produce damage and DPS reports.
descriptions.dandelion: Taking damage triggers a sequence of loaded seed shots. Defeating it releases all remaining seeds at once.
descriptions.ant_egg: A stationary ant egg. Breaking it with an attack may release a baby ant of the same rarity.
descriptions.fire_ant_egg: A stationary fire ant egg. Breaking it with an attack may release a baby fire ant of the same rarity.
descriptions.termite_egg: A termite egg with a psionic connection that can share damage with nearby allies. Breaking it may release a baby termite.
descriptions.queen_ant_egg: An egg laid by a queen ant. Automatically hatches into a soldier ant after a delay, keeping its original team.
descriptions.queen_fire_ant_egg: An egg laid by a fire queen. Automatically hatches into a soldier fire ant after a delay, keeping its original team.
descriptions.baby_fire_ant: A young fire ant that wanders without pursuing enemies. Breaking a fire ant egg may release one.
descriptions.worker_fire_ant: Wanders until provoked, then chases its attacker. Its fire ant damage bonus makes lingering in contact dangerous.
descriptions.fire_queen_ant: Lays eggs in combat that automatically hatch into soldier fire ants. Watch for newly hatched soldiers as you approach.
descriptions.baby_termite: A young termite that wanders without chasing enemies. Its psionic connection lets it share damage with nearby connected allies.
descriptions.worker_termite: A termite worker that wanders until provoked. Its psionic connection shares incoming damage with nearby connected allies.
descriptions.termite_overmind: A psionically connected termite leader that retaliates when provoked. Super, Eternal, Unique and Primordial individuals periodically disable petal slots on nearby enemy flowers.
descriptions.leaf_piece: A leaf fragment that cannot move by itself. Leafcutter soldiers seek suitable pieces and carry them along.
descriptions.leafcutter_soldier: Pursues enemies and picks up suitable leaf pieces. Carrying a leaf restricts how quickly it can turn.
descriptions.titan: A giant flower with amplified stats that retaliates when provoked. It periodically refreshes its loadout from available Unique petals, so its equipment can vary.
descriptions.firefly: Chases attackers when provoked. Below Super, lightning retaliation requires a direct hit from a mob other than a player flower. Super retaliates against other attack sources too; higher rarities also discharge proactively. Eternal, Unique and Primordial individuals can summon creatures in combat.
descriptions.magic_firefly: Uses magic chain lightning with the same retaliation and active-discharge conditions as ordinary fireflies. Eternal, Unique and Primordial individuals can summon magic fireflies of their own rarity in combat.
descriptions.firefly_larva: Its head leads a chain of body segments. It latches onto enemies and repeatedly applies poison; its head and segments can also strengthen magic lightning passing through them.
